channel.title: YUGRIND Blog (en)
channel.description: Festival news, results and practical guides for live tournament poker players in Europe.

item.title: Paris Gaming Clubs: Experimental Framework
item.description: Article 34 of the law of 28 February 2017 created an experimental framework for Paris gaming clubs. The first licensed clubs opened in 2018.

item.title: Adam Wilkinson wins GUKPT Blackpool Main Event
item.description: Adam Wilkinson won the GUKPT Blackpool Main Event, earning £55,035 from 190 entries. The GUKPT Grand Final 2026 is set for London.

item.title: Tereza Vernerova wins Battle of Malta Autumn Edition
item.description: Tereza Vernerova won the 2026 Battle of Malta Autumn Edition Main Event at Casino Malta, becoming the first woman to claim the title.

item.title: Elena Yasyuchenya wins $3k One-W Championship in Kyrenia
item.description: Elena Yasyuchenya won the $3k One-W Championship in Kyrenia. The event drew 42 entries, with a $112,518 prize pool and seven paid places.

item.title: PokerStars Open Aix Main Event: 859 entries, €130,000 top prize
item.description: The €1,100 PokerStars Open Aix-en-Provence Main Event drew 859 entries and paid €130,000 to first place from a €824,640 prize pool.

item.title: WSOP Circuit Sanremo 2026: tournament schedule
item.description: The WSOP Circuit runs at Casinò di Sanremo from 20 to 30 November 2026, with 11 rings, a €1,500 Main Event and more tournaments.

item.title: Alin Ivan wins $450,000 at Triton ONE QQPK Genesis
item.description: Alin Ivan won the Triton ONE $3,000 QQPK Genesis in North Cyprus, earning $450,000 from 912 entries and a $2,443,248 prize pool.

item.title: Bo Hoebe Wins WSOP Circuit Madrid Main Event
item.description: Bo Hoebe won the 2026 WSOP Circuit Madrid €1,500 Main Event, earning €207,000 and his second gold ring after defeating Jose Barbero heads-up.

item.title: Live Poker Festivals in Europe: December 2026
item.description: See the December 2026 live poker festival schedule across Europe, with dates, venues, Main Event buy-ins and guarantees where listed.

item.title: Autumn Series at Portomaso: Results
item.description: The three-event Autumn Series at Portomaso Casino featured wins for Tomas Svoboda, Alberto Furnari and Aleksandar Kosarkoski.
